instructions.title: Instructions

text_lines.text: 1. Type/copy-paste the names of pupils/students and other important information in the Modified SF1 worksheet.
2. Click "June" button to access the June sheet. And type the dates in the appropriate cells.
3. Hide unused rows so that they will not appear in the final printout. You can unhide them anytime if you need to.
4. Indicate the date in the appropriate cell before checking the attendance of pupils/students every day. Computation will only take place if the date is specified.
5. (IMPORTANT) Type "E" in the appropriate cell to indicate entry of pupil/student during the first school-week of June. If the pupil/student is a late enrollee,
type "LE". If he/she is a transferree in your school, type T/I. Failing to indicate "E", "LE" or "T/I" will exclude the child from your class register.
6. When checking the attendance of pupils/students, leave the cell BLANK if the pupil/student is present.
7. To work on the form for the succeeding months, you must choose the appropriate tab/button and repeat Steps 3 & 4.
1. If you wish to use this program, you must start in the month of JUNE. But if you haven't done so, please copy the entries from your SF2 starting in June.
2. Name entry can only be done in the Modified SF1 worksheet.
3. Hyperlink buttons are provided for easy navigation across worksheets.
4. Do not erase or rearrange your entries in the Modified SF1 worksheet as this will affect the monthly and annual summaries.
5. Year-round summary of Attendance and Tardiness is available in this program. You may access it by clicking the "Summary" button.
6. Consolidation of your enrollment data can be accessed by clicking the "Conso" button.
Programmed by: Al Stephen R. Lagumen
